speaker: miriam
comment: Entries are checked top to bottom; the first whose conditions hold starts the conversation.

no_letter.text: Oh! Good morning! I left a letter for you at your house, but here you are anyway.

greet.text: Good morning, my friend! You found my letter.

plant_offer.text: The soil is warm, and these bean seeds are waiting for a home. Will you plant the row with me?

plant_go.text: Wonderful. Come, kneel down here beside me.

later.text: That's all right. The seeds will wait. Come back whenever you're ready.

after_planting.text: Look at our neat row! Now the beans need sun, rain, and time.

after_planting_2.text: If you'd like a quiet place, the chapel is just over the bridge, beside the village.

growing.text: Come and look! Do you see the little green loops pushing up? Bean sprouts come up bent over, as if they're bowing.

growing_2.text: Each day they'll stretch a little taller. I wonder how tall they'll be by summer.

table.text: I passed your house and saw the table all set for supper. What a lovely welcome!

taller.text: The bean sprouts have opened their first leaves! They're standing up straight now, reaching for the light.

taller_2.text: I smelled fresh bread on the way here. I think Mr. Tobias could use a helper this morning.

mustard_wonder.text: Every seed in this garden makes me think of the mustard seed story. It starts so tiny, and look how big it grows!

loaves_wonder.text: When I pack my basket, I think of the boy with five loaves and two fish. It was a small lunch, and he gave it all to Jesus! I wonder what he thought.

watered.text: Thank you for watering the beans! Look, there are little green beans hanging down now.

orchard_offer.text: There you are! Here are our three little apple trees. Would you please help me plant them in a row?

orchard_go.text: Thank you! Bring the long stick, and we'll start.

orchard_later.text: That's all right. The trees will wait here in their bundle.

card_offer.text: Mrs. Ruth has been so kind to us. Shall we make her a thank-you card, with the flowers I pressed?

card_go.text: Lovely. Gentle fingers, now. Pressed flowers are delicate.

card_later.text: That's all right. The flowers will keep.

rest_day.text: Good morning, my friend! It's Sunday, so there is no work today. Even the garden rests. Listen: can you hear the bells?
